notes.title: January 8 Patch
notes.notes:
Game now runs in background
Added more resolution options including 5k and 4k support
Resolution option is now remembered between sessions
Resolution is detected and automatically set if no preference was selected
Fixed mute audio having rectangular button and blurry text
Fixed resolution option being set to wrong option, preventing it from being set to that option
Fixed bug caused by clicking time control buttons while holding a tower during the preparation phase
Fixed errors caused by pressing left and right mouse button too quickly when selecting a tower
Fixed enemies continuing to hit the wall after being pushed away from it by the Water Tower
Fixed an off center tower placement node on Level 3
Fixed the Water Tower's wave appearing off-track
Fixed the Water Tower's wave's sound effect not being paused
Fixed Flamethrower not spawning Burning Oil when both upgrades are purchased
Slight optimizations

notes.title: January 6 Hotfix Patch
notes.notes:
Fixed Ice Tower and Fire Tower Flamethrower considering wave an enemy and causing some errors
Fixed an error caused by returning to the main menu
Fixed an uncommon game-breaking freeze that occurred when ending a level
Fixed some effects like Boil and Burning Oil not being placed correctly when targeting enemies at the gate
Slightly optimized some scripts

notes.title: January 4 Update
notes.notes:
fixed a potential error caused by enemy dying while being pushed by the wave
 fixed crashes related to Lightning Ricochet
 fixed Lightning Ricochet not triggering on Arc flash or Bounce
 changed Lightning Ricochet timing to work with other upgrades
 fixed Lightning Ricochet not resetting attack speed back to normal
 fixed Gatling Protocol reverting Armor-Piercing Rounds attack speed change
 fixed some potential issues with purchasing upgrades while certain upgrades' effects are happening
 fixed wagon freezing when time controls are manipulated in certain ways
